integrity: The primary source was checked for its fixed-value corollary, explicit open problem, date, and primary MSC. The new upper obstruction is derived independently from an exact coefficient expansion of a squared disk automorphism. The majorant defect reduces to a cubic whose endpoint signs and strict monotonicity are proved algebraically. The decimal endpoint is only an evaluation of the unique root of an exact cubic.
scientific_limitations: The result supplies an explicit degree-two Blaschke upper curve for the fixed-value majorant radius only in the range 0<rho<=1/3. It does not prove global extremality of that Blaschke product, determine the exact fixed-value radius, or treat the larger-rho sign regimes.
title: A degree-two Blaschke upper curve for fixed-value Bohr majorants
